name: Nyere
description: Nyere ndi tizilombo tomwe timawononga mbewu pofuna kuteteza nsabwe zomwe zimatulutsa timadzi tokoma. Zimamanga zisa m'mizu ndipo zimawononga mbewu mwachindunji.
cure: Gwiritsani ntchito nyambo, kuwaza diatomaceous earth kuzungulira mbewu, kuwononga nsabwe, kapena mankhwala opha tizilombo ngati zavuta kwambiri.

name: Njuchi
description: Njuchi ndi zofunika kwambiri pakufalitsa mungu. Koma mitundu ina imadula masamba kumanga zisa. Izi sizipha mbewu koma zimachepetsa mphamvu ya dzuwa.
cure: Palibe chithandizo chofunikira chifukwa ndi zothandiza. Ngati zawononga kwambiri, gwiritsani ntchito zotchinga kapena kuwapatsa malo ena omangira zisa.

name: Kachidontho
description: Kachidontho amawononga masamba, maluwa, ndi zipatso. Ana ake amawononga mizu pomwe akulu amadya masamba. Mitundu yake ndi yambiri kuphatikiza yowononga mbatata ndi nkhaka.
cure: Tolani manja, gwiritsani ntchito zotchinga, kuwaza neem oil kapena sopo wophera tizilombo, kapena mankhwala opha tizilombo ngati zavuta.

name: Mphutsi
description: Mphutsi ndi ana a gulugufe. Zimawononga masamba, kuboola zipatso, ndipo zingathe kuwononga mbewu yonse. Zimaphatikizapo mphutsi za masamba a kabichi ndi tomato.
cure: Tolani manja, gwiritsani ntchito Bt (Bacillus thuringiensis), kuwaza neem oil, gwiritsani ntchito zotchinga, kapena kulimbikitsa mbalame ndi tizilombo tomwe timadya mphutsi.

name: Nyongolotsi
description: Nyongolotsi ndi zothandiza kwambiri chifukwa zimalowetsa mpweya m'nthaka ndi kuwonjezera zakudya. Koma dothi lawo limatha kusokoneza malo, ndipo limakopa nyama zina.
cure: Palibe chithandizo chofunikira - ndi zothandiza. Ngati zikuvutitsa, tolani ndi kugwiritsa ntchito ngati feteleza, kapena kuwongolera madzi m'nthaka.

name: Khutu
description: Khutu ndi tizilombo tomwe timadya zowola koma timatha kuwononga mbande, zipatso zofewa, ndi maluwa. Zimabisala m'malo amdima ndi onyowa masana.
cure: Gwiritsani ntchito misampha ya nyuzipepala, kuwaza diatomaceous earth, chepetsani chinyontho, kapena mankhwala opha tizilombo ngati zavuta.

name: Dzombe
description: Dzombe ndi tizilombo tomwe timadya masamba ambiri, makamaka pamene tachuluka. Zimawononga masamba, nthambi, ndi mbewu, ndipo zimatha kuwononga mbewu zambiri.
cure: Gwiritsani ntchito zotchinga, kuwaza neem oil, kulimbikitsa mbalame ndi akangaude, kapena kugwiritsa ntchito Nosema locustae.

name: Njenjete
description: Njenjete zazikulu siziwononga, koma ana awo amatha kuwononga kwambiri mbewu. Mitundu ina ndi yowononga kwambiri m'minda ya zipatso ndi masamba.
cure: Gwiritsani ntchito misampha, kuwaza Bt kwa ana, gwiritsani ntchito zotchinga, sinthanitsani mbewu, kapena kugwiritsa ntchito tizilombo tomwe timadya ana a njenjete.

name: Nkhono
description: Nkhono zimakonda malo onyowa. Zimadya masamba, mbande, ndipo zimasiya mizere ya madzi. Zingathe kuwononga mbande mu usiku umodzi.
cure: Gwiritsani ntchito misampha ya mowa, zotchinga zamkuwa, kuwaza diatomaceous earth, kulimbikitsa achule ndi mbalame, kapena kugwiritsa ntchito nyambo.

name: Kholowa
description: Kholowa ndi ngati nkhono koma ali ndi chipolopolo. Amadya masamba, nthambi, ndi zipatso, kusiya mizere ya madzi. Amagwira ntchito usiku.
cure: Tolani manja usiku, gwiritsani ntchito zotchinga zamkuwa, kuwaza diatomaceous earth, chotsani malo obisalamo, kapena kugwiritsa ntchito nyambo.

name: Mavu
description: Mavu ambiri ndi othandiza chifukwa amadya tizilombo tina. Koma mitundu ina imawononga zipatso, ndipo kupezeka kwawo pafupi ndi mbewu kumatha kusokoneza.
cure: Palibe chithandizo chofunikira - ndi othandiza. Ngati ali ovuta, gwiritsani ntchito misampha, chotsani zisa mosamala, kapena zotchinga.

name: Nyenyezi
description: Nyenyezi ndi tizilombo tating'ono tomwe timawononga masamba, nthambi, ndi mizu. Ana ake amadya mkati mwa mbewu, kupangitsa kufota ndi kufa.
cure: Gwiritsani ntchito misampha, kuwaza nematodes othandiza, chotsani mbali zowonongeka, gwiritsani ntchito zotchinga, kapena mankhwala opha tizilombo.
